messages:
elaine_sales: FYI SpectraBank POC kickoff today. They need PrivateLink (interface endpoint) + fixed egress IP(s) for allowlist. Also security team will send questionnaire. Can we confirm tech constraints? :wave:

max_netops: Quick Q: do they need source IP preservation from client to our infra, or just stable egress IP for firewall allowlist?

elaine_sales: They need stable egress IPs from our side (for their outbound firewall). They also prefer not to run proxy inside their VPC. Customer notes potential TLS inspection requirement.

max_netops: Options:
1) PrivateLink (Interface endpoint) + NAT egress via our managed egress NAT (static EIP) — simple but adds egress cost.
2) Customer-hosted proxy -> us via PrivateLink -> source IP not preserved.
3) Transit/peering + TGW (more complex) to preserve client srcIP.

Snippet for minimal allowlist they'd ask for:
```
Outbound to Redwood:
- dst: 13.48.12.34/32 (example endpoint)
- port: 443 (TLS)
- protocol: TCP
- DNS: allow outbound to 8.8.8.8/53 or their resolver
```

aj_prodeng: For POC scale, recommend PrivateLink + static EIP on our egress fleet. If they need <5k rps it's fine. Pricing note: PrivateLink interface endpoint + data processing fees (~$0.01/GB) + egress costs apply. If they commit to Dedicated capacity we can provide pricing credits to offset endpoint fees.

sarah_security: On the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II report once NDA is signed, KMS integrations supported (customer-managed keys for Private deployments), and we log connection metadata in Console (retention configurable). TLS inspection: we don't terminate customer TLS on-host unless requested via a managed proxy offering.

elaine_sales: Action items: Max please post minimal firewall snippet to hand to customer. Aj prepare a rough cost delta (PrivateLink vs Dedicated) for the POC by EOD. Sarah, expect their sec questionnaire in ~30m.

max_netops: Posted firewall snippet to Confluence: https://redwood.co/confluence/poc/spectrafirewall (placeholder). Also added note: If they insist on TLS-inspect, we'll need a design call.

deploy-bot: Ticket #POC-4492 created for SpectraBank POC network tasks — assignees: max_netops, aj_prodeng, sarah_security

elaine_sales: Thanks — looping in customer lead to confirm timelines. :thumbsup:
